about.title: About Leader Assurance
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner for over 10 years
about.description1: Leader Assurance SARL is an insurance consulting and brokerage firm based in Douala, Cameroon. We assist individuals and companies in managing their risks and protecting their assets.
about.description2: Our independent approach allows us to select the best offers on the market to provide you with tailor-made solutions, adapted to your specific needs.
about.missionText: To offer superior quality, personalized and transparent insurance advisory services, enabling our clients to make the best protection decisions.
about.visionText: To become the reference insurance brokerage firm in Central Africa, recognized for its expertise, integrity and commitment to excellence.
